verdict.rationale: Docs confirm dbt transformations are natively supported (meltano-docs-6) and pipelines including dbt workflows can be orchestrated (meltano-docs-7, meltano-docs-25), implying transform steps are chained to extract-load runs rather than being a separate service. However, no evidence explicitly shows a single 'meltano run' invocation triggering dbt immediately after fresh load completion versus a time-based schedule, nor any hands-on confirmation of this dependency-driven execution. Missing for 10: explicit example/documentation of EL+T chained in one pipeline run, evidence of dependency-triggered (not just time-scheduled) execution, and independent confirmation of this workflow in production.
